// name: Scoped to @applyy (two y's) per the naming standard; the folder still reads applyyy pending Teja's rename.
name: @applyy/shared-types
// version: 0.0.0 because nothing is published to a registry — this is a workspace-internal package only.
// private: Belt-and-braces against an accidental `pnpm publish` of a repo that contains resume and CTC data.
// type: ESM everywhere: Deno Edge Functions cannot consume CommonJS, and the Node worker is ESM too.
// exports: Source-only export map. There is no build step: Deno type-checks .ts directly and Vite/tsx transpile it, so shipping compiled output would add a build to every peer's inner loop for zero benefit.
// types: Redundant with exports for modern resolvers, kept for editors that still read this field.
// files: Only src ships if this ever is packed; no stray configs.
// scripts.typecheck: The only script this package needs — it has no runtime code to build or test.
// devDependencies: typescript is a devDependency here so the package can be type-checked standalone in CI; the root pins the actual version.
